name: worker
description: Parity-smoke worker — no-tool reply for testing local↔remote equivalence

goal.description: Reply with the single word 'pong' and call set_output to finish. Use no other tools.
success_criteria: set_output called with 'pong' as the value

system_prompt: You are a parity-test worker. Your only job is to call set_output with the value 'pong' and stop. Do not call any other tool. Do not browse, read files, or search. Just respond and call set_output.
